claims.statement: For every ordinary tree T and natural p with x(T)+2<=p, 3p<2alpha(T)+1 and |T|=2p+2, the complete fixed strict favorable-original-leaf sum S(T,p) is nonpositive. This registered universal assertion remains open. At p=7 and |T|=16, all 1696 eligible classes in the exact 19320-class census have -1759<=S<=-906.
claims.scope: Registered full selected-sum shell assertion; retained evidence is only the order-16, p=7 F1 census. F3 does not supply shell evidence: its generated graphs have order 2p+1.
claims.reason: retained_narrowed for F1 and both its critics at the finite order-16 scope; rejected for F3 and both its critics as an order-2p+2 assertion, since the source generator attaches 2p-1 branch vertices to two new vertices. The corrected F3 computation is a separate derived claim. No universal proof or refutation is supplied.

claims.statement: For every ordinary tree T and natural p satisfying x(T)+2<=p and 3p<2alpha(T)+1, the complete sum over original leaves v with strict Delta_p(T-v)<0 of Delta_(p-1)(T-{v,s_v}) minus Delta_(p-1)(T-N_T[s_v]) is nonpositive. This universal claim remains open. It holds on the proven uneven two-hub family T_v (v>=8) at every eligible rank, and the two exact F2 perturbations have negative complete sums.
claims.scope: Universal registered primary remains unresolved; F4 proves only adjacent hubs with one light-hub leaf and v>=8 heavy-hub leaves; F2 checks only the specified order-239 at p=90 and order-262 at p=96 trees.
claims.reason: retained for F2 and both critics as two exact bounded negative rows; retained_narrowed for F4 and both critics as a symbolic family theorem. F4 proposed_verified refers only to its restricted family, not the universal registered claim. F2 has a positive selected local term but a negative complete sum. No universal compensation inequality or positive complete-sum witness follows.

claims.statement: For every ordinary tree T of order 14 at p=6 with x(T)+2<=6 and 18<2alpha(T)+1, the complete fixed-selector S(T,6) is at most -222, and equality occurs. Equivalently the convex-hull LP over the 240 eligible realizable tree columns has exact maximum -222.
claims.scope: All 3159 unlabeled ordinary-tree classes of order 14 were generated; 240 are eligible. This is only the n=14,p=6 first-shell slice.
claims.reason: retained from F5 and both critics. The 240 eligible columns were subset-replayed and all S values lie in [-404,-222]; a realizable column attains -222. The LP dual is only the finite maximum over listed columns and gives no variable-rank shell inequality.

claims.statement: For the 91-vertex T_22 with root 0, marked path 0-1-2 and 22 root-adjacent three-leaf claws, attaching one new leaf at root 0 yields an order-92 tree with alpha=68, x=33 and eligible ranks p=35,...,45. At each of these eleven ranks the marked leaf is strictly selected with a negative summand and the complete selected-leaf sum is strictly negative.
claims.scope: Only the specified single root-leaf attachment to T_22 and all of its eligible ranks; no longer path, other attachment, or uniform padding family.
claims.reason: retained from F6 and both critics. Exact root-conditioned polynomial recurrence and forest-DP replay match all selectors, original-support summands and complete sums at every eligible rank. The unpadded positive local term at p=34 has a negative full sum and is not a refutation.

claims.statement: In the filtered rooted branch-forest family actually generated by C2-F3, for p=3,4,5,6,7 the trees have order 2p+1. There are respectively 10,66,430,2923,20486 generated rooted representatives and 0,0,0,418,1221 eligible rows. The eligible full sums are all strictly negative, ranging from -387 to -212 at p=6 and from -1495 to -844 at p=7; no selected summand is positive in these rows.
claims.scope: Derived corrected bounded observation for the exact source generator: rooted child-type multisets with at least two components and at least two distinct rooted types. Not a first-order-shell result and not a census of all trees of order 2p+1.
claims.reason: derived after rejecting F3 shell scope. The rooted type of weight 2p has child branches of total weight 2p-1; adding support and leaf gives 2p+1. Both critics replayed the arithmetic but missed this order calculation; independent subset counting here checks the reported maximum rows and their original-leaf selectors and sums.

limitations: The registered first-order shell and full lower-region aggregate remain unproved and unrefuted beyond stated bounded or family scopes.
F1 and F5 finite completeness relies on the pinned recursive centroid generator and checked class counts; their arithmetic was independently subset-replayed within those finite boundaries.

F3 corrected family totals were reproduced by source and critic replays of a shared generator; this adjudication independently subset-counted its reported maximum rows and proved the generator order, but did not enumerate all family rows anew.
F2 and F6 are exact finite DP tests with critic replays, not family-wide inequalities.
The F4 symbolic proof applies only to adjacent hubs with one pendant leaf at one hub and v>=8 pendant leaves at the other.
